publishedRecipe.name: Ground Beef & Mixed Veggie Skillet with Mashed Potato Topping

cookwares.name: stainless steel or cast iron skillet

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
4 medium yellow potatoes
4 medium carrots
4 sticks celery

instructions.primary_message: Peel and medium dice potatoes; place in a medium saucepan and cover with hot water (from the tap). Cover and bring to a boil over high heat; once boiling, reduce to a simmer and cook until soft, 10-12 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel, trim, and small dice carrots; trim and small dice celery. Place both in a medium bowl.
Preheat a large ovenproof skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add beef and cook, breaking it apart with a spoon, until just browned, 3-4 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ lb lean ground beef

instructions.primary_message: While the beef cooks, peel, halve, and small dice onion; peel and mince garlic. Add both to the bowl with the carrot and celery.
When the beef is done, add veggies and spices to the skillet; continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies soften, 4-5 minutes more.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tsp rosemary, dried
1 tsp thyme, dried
1 tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, preheat oven to broil on high and position rack about 6-inches from the top.
When the potatoes are done, drain in a colander and return to the saucepan. Add milk, salt, and pepper; using a potato masher, mash until smooth. Cover to keep warm and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
8 fl oz (1 cup) whole milk
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: When the veggies are soft, add flour and cook, stirring frequently, 1 minute more.
Add tomato sauce, broth, peas, and Worcestershire to the skillet; stir to combine the beef filling and bring to a simmer. Once simmering, remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 (8 oz) cans tomato sauce
8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth
1 cup frozen peas
4 tsp Worcestershire sauce

instructions.primary_message: Spoon mashed potatoes over the beef filling; using a fork, evenly spread mashed potatoes over the top, creating ridges.
Place skillet in the oven and broil until the top is set and lightly golden, 2-3 minutes. Remove from oven.
To serve, divide the skillet between plates or bowls and enjoy!
